## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `c2fb9eeecae07dbddeb2d615e5a1c6539e5eff07`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md + packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.package-docs.test.ts, packages/core (declaredDependencyIds), .changeset/27209-pages-embed-scope.md

### ① Derived judgments
- (a) TRUE only for packages the artifact carries: `embedScope` (collect-docs.ts:1425–1434) resolves `declaredDependencyIds(body)` via `bodyById` (this artifact's packages) and drops any other id; a stack with no `packages[]` gets `[[stack], []]`, its `manifest.dependencies` never read (test :830). Over-states — ④.
- (b) direct only: TRUE — `declaredDependencyIds` (packages/core/src/artifact-packages.ts:196) is `Object.keys(dependencies)`, no transitive walk.
- (c) one-way: TRUE — deps come from the owner's body alone; test :779.
- (d) fails the build: TRUE — each miss is `severity: 'error'` (:1057–1076); compile.ts:1002–1021 exits 1.
- (e) names the scope: 3 of 4 — `scope` (:1024) is absent from the rule-name miss (:1066).
- (f) broken-link posture: TRUE — `docs/broken-link` is `error` too (:898).
- (g) render-time: unchanged, TRUE — metadata-viewer.tsx:118–155 `failed`/`notFound` render `Placeholder`; MarkdownImpl.tsx:148 falls back to `pre`.
- Flat `src/docs/`: `embedScope(flatOwner?.index)` (:1439) = top level + manifest-named package + its carried deps; "this package" as the package the doc ships on is right. Link rule at :335 is `lintDocs` :883–905 against `artifactNames`, untouched — right to leave.

### ② Semver level
`patch` is right: `@objectstack/skills` (package.json `files: ["dist", …]`, not private) ships `skills/**` via `sync-catalog`; AGENTS.md:1019–1021 keeps `skip-changeset` for a diff publishing nothing. `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` (kind none → patch) line-initial in both bodies; Check Changeset green.

### ③ Boundary flags
- open_question (report first line): A — post-stamped.mjs:468–477 refuses an unsigned body and `stripSignatureLine` skips one; check-half-states.mjs `OS_DEV_REPORT_MARKER` admits a leading signature.
- Dev 1 (changeset over label): correct, per ②.
- Dev 2 (+24 vs +12): the ceiling binds; 5691/5692 reproduced; accepted, the wording below lands at 5689.
- Dev 3 (3 gates NOT MEASURED): accepted — `Lint & Repo Gates` success on the head at read time.
- Dev 4 (trailers) and Dev 5 (43/40/3/0): accepted; the trailers are the model-free pair AGENTS.md requires.
- Ratchet: "naming the scope it judged" (~8 tokens) describes a refusal, not what the author writes, and is 3-of-4 true — drop it; it pays for the fix (must-fix, in ④).

### ④ Design judgment
Card scenarios hold: a declared sibling's state machine builds (test :772), an undeclared sibling's is refused (:765); closed form, no "may". But the sentence teaches a capability the build does not deliver: a dependency declared on a package installed separately (ADR-0141 D3's other arm) is never searched — a single-package stack reads no `dependencies`, a composed one drops uncarried ids — so an author embedding an installed app's flow gets "does not exist in this package" (picklist-references.ts:45 only reports such deps; that lint-vs-render gap is its own card).
must-fix: replace pages.md:397–401 with exactly:
```
the referenced object-rule / flow / permission set **must exist in this
package or in a package of the same artifact that it declares in
`manifest.dependencies`** (direct only; one-way) — anything else fails the
build (same posture as a broken link). At render time a missing or forbidden
reference degrades to a placeholder, never a crash.
```
(22756 B → 5689/5692, headroom 3; longest line 76.)

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27209-pages-embed-scope`
Reviewed-by: `session_017xRBcUi2qhP1eKRbZJ1Ze1`

**VERDICT: FAIL**

Seat note: review run by an isolated at-tier reviewer agent, adopted by the seat (`domain:skills#1`) at 2026-10-28T16:04Z; the patch round goes back to the original dev on the same branch and claim; a delta review of the fixing commit follows.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `60b713f64a2844b1dc6fa59a7a33a1ec5fc94caa`
Local-runs: none
Scope: skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md + packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts, packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.package-docs.test.ts, packages/core (declaredDependencyIds), .changeset/27209-pages-embed-scope.md

### ① Derived judgments
Delta since 6474059798 (one commit, `c2fb9eee..60b713f6`, 2 files, +5/−5):
- (a) CLOSED — pages.md:397–401 at the head are byte-identical to the must-fix hunk; "a package of the same artifact that it declares in `manifest.dependencies`" now matches `embedScope` (collect-docs.ts:1425–1434, `bodyById` = this artifact's packages) and the single-package path (`[[stack], []]`, test :830).
- (e) CLOSED — "naming the scope it judged" is gone from the sentence; the 3-of-4 refusal text is no longer claimed.
- (b) direct only, (c) one-way, (d) fails the build, (f) broken-link posture, (g) render-time sentence: unchanged from 6474059798, all TRUE; the render-time line is byte-unchanged in the delta.
- Flat `src/docs/` owner and the link rule at :335: unchanged from 6474059798 — right to leave.

### ② Semver level
Unchanged: `@objectstack/skills: patch`. The changeset at the head keeps the frontmatter and the line-initial `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none`; its title and body now say "a package of the same artifact … (direct only; one-way)" and no longer claim the refusal names the scope. Check Changeset green on `60b713f6`.

### ③ Boundary flags
- Token ratchet: the dev's 5689 / 5692 (headroom 3) is reproduced — 22756 B → `ceil(22756/4)` = 5689; longest line 76 cols.
- Nothing else moved: `git diff --stat c2fb9eee..60b713f6` = the two files only; `git diff origin/main...60b713f6` is still the same two files (+14/−3), merge-base `fa5e7825` unchanged; the fixing commit carries the model-free trailer pair.
- Note, not a must-fix: the PR body's "After:" quote and its 5691 / 5692 readings are superseded; the seat refreshes those passages (the dev does not PATCH a PR body) and the declaration lines stay intact.
- open_question and deviations 1–5: answered in 6474059798, unchanged.

### ④ Design judgment
Both card scenarios hold against the code (declared sibling of the same artifact builds, test :772; undeclared sibling refused, :765), and the sentence now also refuses what the build refuses: a dependency installed outside the artifact is excluded by the words, so no author writes an embed the build rejects or avoids one it accepts. Closed form — no "may", no tolerance. The lint-vs-render gap on outside dependencies (picklist-references.ts:45 reports, `lintMetadataEmbeds` refuses) remains a card of its own, not this PR's.
must-fix: none.

Implemented-by: `claude/issue-27209-pages-embed-scope`
Reviewed-by: `session_017xRBcUi2qhP1eKRbZJ1Ze1`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## 维护者速读(席位终稿,钉 head `60b713f6`)

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md`〈Inline metadata views〉里 `os build` 的 lint 句,从「被引用项必须存在于本包」改为「必须存在于本包,或同一产物内本包在 `manifest.dependencies` 里声明的包(仅直接依赖、单向)」,其余引用照旧构建失败;另加 `@objectstack/skills` 的 patch changeset(`skills/**` 随该包发布,AGENTS.md 清单第 3 步)。
- 为什么改:平台已按本包 + 同产物内声明的直接依赖判定嵌入(PR #27204 落地的 `docs/metadata-embed-ref`),技能文档仍教更窄的规则,AI 作者会为了嵌入而重复声明元数据;技能面要陈述平台强制的闭合规则。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时改动,一句技能文字加一份 changeset;回滚即 revert。该文件 token 读数 5689 / 上限 5692(余量 3)。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` 第 397–401 行;措辞对照 `packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts:1425–1434` 的 `embedScope`(本包主体 + `declaredDependencyIds` 在本产物 `bodyById` 内能找到的包,单向)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 打印 `pages.md is 5689 tokens (ceiling 5692; headroom 3)` 且退出 0。
- 需要你做的:`skills/**` 是 Tier H 受管面,请 `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`(os-zhuang / hotlong,已由中继请审)之一 approve;批准在案后由席位落地(ready + auto-merge)。
- 席位意见:ACCEPT。首版句子多教了一项平台不兑现的能力(对单独安装的包声明的依赖不在搜索范围),达档契约复核 FAIL 后同分支一轮补丁收窄为「同一产物内」,复核 PASS;changeset 归属正确。

## 席位核对

- 形态:draft PR,目标 `main`,正文首行 `Fixes #27209`,`Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` 在 PR 正文与 changeset 正文各一份;assignee `sunhaolin`;两文件,两个 commit(`c2fb9eee` 初版、`60b713f6` 补丁)。
- 前提实测:`origin/main` 上 `collect-docs.ts:1425` `embedScope` = 包主体 + `declaredDependencyIds(body)` 经 `bodyById` 解析出的同产物包(未携带的 id 丢弃;无 `packages[]` 的栈返回 `[[stack], []]`);测试 `a declaration is one-way`;旧句「must exist in this package」在合并基 `fa5e7825` 仍在。
- 门禁 check-runs(钉 head `60b713f6`,本席读数时刻见戳):36 check-runs: skipped 14, success 19, in_progress 3; not yet green: Lint · CI, release & engine gates, Plan Test Core shards, Type Check · consumer gates
- 接受的偏差:① 本席「skills-only 取 `skip-changeset`」的假设被 dev 以 AGENTS.md 第 1020 行与 `packages/skills/package.json` `files: [dist, …]` 证伪,改为 patch changeset,正确;② 相对合并基净 +22 token,对席位预算 ≤ +12:预算读数过期(按旧 main 5680 算),棘轮余量 3 为真读数,本席接受;③ 三个 build 依赖门禁族本地 NOT MEASURED,由 CI `Lint · docs & code guards` 承担;④ 报告评论首行为席位署名、次行 `os-dev-report`(中继写工具要求,识别器跳过署名行)—— 答 dev 问题:A;⑤ PR 正文仍描述初版句子与 5691 读数,按 os-dev 规则 dev 不 PATCH 正文,以本评论与复核记录为准。
- 范围外去向:`pages.md:335` 链接句经代码核对不过期(`lintDocs` 对产物全名集判同前缀链接),不改;`docs/broken-link` 报错文案比所判范围窄(class b 候选,无生产者改写请求)—— Acceptance notes,不立卡;复核 ④ 提到的「对单独安装的包声明的依赖,lint 不搜而渲染可达」的缺口 —— 不在本卡范围,记入轮报交分诊,本席不立卡;`Skills-docs:` 不欠(kind `none`)。
- 落地条款:Tier H,等授权批准;批准后席位过落地前检(`check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 27304`、两 required job 绿、全 check 绿或预期 skip)再 ready + auto-merge。契约复核记录:FAIL 6474059798(head `c2fb9eee`)→ delta PASS 6474235904(head `60b713f6`)。
